parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key, 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters (`400 idempotency-key-required` when absent, `400 idempotency-key-invalid` when malformed). A retry with the same key, method, path and body returns the first response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with anything else is `409 idempotency-key-reused`.
